Quavo and Lana Del Rey are expressing that being ‘tough’ is being reliant on your actions in the present to carry you through tribulations as opposed to dwelling on an ideal post-tribulation future without taking any actionable steps to achieve that.

Perhaps Lana Del Rey and Quavo are trying to show that the idea of having true ‘toughness’ is persevering despite the cards you have been dealt in life, and looking to forge a brighter future for the betterment of yourself and those around you.
